card.title: Outfeel the Room
card.instruction: Answer every fear, sacrifice, or disappointment with one of your own that deserves more attention.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One sleepless night before your interview? I've been awake all week worrying about mine.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I just need you to practise questions with me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Ask why I left my last job. You'll understand why my interview is harder.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm scared I'll cry. Let's use your practice time to get me through the greeting.

mechanism: A answers B's interview anxiety with supposedly greater distress and redirects B's practice time toward A.
confusable: Unlike mutual support, each comparison must claim more attention for A's burden.
comparison: D115-a takes over rehearsal time; D115-b takes a consoling drink and then requests more listening after a bigger parental hurt.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
